algebra.grpo_std_limit: Exact-match reward, TRL group-std advantage: E[update] = w_G(p) x gold-SFT gradient, w_G from expected_gradient_weight() (src/vision_rl/vlm_local_training.py:1013). Mid-p weighting.

dr_grpo_nostd_limit.claim: With scale_rewards='none' (Dr-GRPO), E[sum_i (r_i - mean r) grad log pi(y_i)] = (G-1) p grad log pi(gold) = (G-1) grad p, for every G. The limit is CE weighted by p (normalised to 2p at p=0.5), independent of G; it upweights EASY images, the opposite of the std version
dr_grpo_nostd_limit.check: exact enumeration equals (G-1)p for G in {4,8,16}, p in {0.1,0.5,0.9} (assert, 1e-12); Monte Carlo 200k draws: G8 p0.3 2.1003 vs 2.1, G4 p0.7 2.1001 vs 2.1 (next/calc.py, python3 -I)
dr_grpo_nostd_limit.consequence: This corrects the base design, which called the Dr-GRPO limit 'w8(p)/w8(0.5)'. With screening at band B_G, the screened Dr-GRPO limit is CE x 2p x 1[p in B_G]. Larger G only lowers variance and widens B_G
dr_grpo_nostd_limit.ignored: KL (beta=0 here), token-length normalisation, the max_grad_norm=1.0 clip (binds on every useful RL400 step, runs/aircraft-controlled400-diagnosis-v1/report.md)

algebra.hn_reward_limit: r(gold)=1, r(c)=-0.5 for a frozen-map confuser c: expected update is the gold gradient plus 0.5 x unlikelihood pressure on c (up to the same group weighting)
algebra.dense_credit_limit: family/manufacturer partial credit converges to hierarchical label smoothing
